archive_only_qualifications.message: Reviewed OCR with retained source evidence; prose headnotes and notes remain in the ordered method excerpt.
Ingredient and method excerpts retain wrapped source lines. Small printed measure/yield discrepancies remain as approved.

generic_coverage_scopes: Dependency coverage has not been reviewed against the current source.
Retained source knowledge; dependency applicability not reviewed.
Retained attached source context; cooking applicability is unreviewed.
generic_coverage_limitations: Read the source for missing preparations; unknown coverage does not mean no dependencies.
Source delivery does not certify a complete recipe or reviewed dependency coverage.

definitions.unreviewed_alternatives: Additional source context is separate from the selected formula. It may describe alternatives; applicability is unreviewed. Do not merge it into selected ingredients or method.
definitions.unknown_coverage: Unknown dependency coverage does not establish no dependencies or complete cooking instructions. Read linked preparations and specific limitations.
